rho_reference.protocol: The component is measured inside ic price on rule v3 k0n53/T01 (aimed m = 3 collection, m = 2 descent, 27,984 base points, 264 columns), the recipe of the board's rule v7 one-target row for icv1-f2m53-tm56619371-dac20a85. That row's matched reference is rule v7's same-process signed-Frobenius rho on each public target, cross-checked against the strong signed-Frobenius walk (research/ic_tool_program/rule/v7/VALIDATION.json, validated). Both arms of this study count identical operations on these params, so the change moves no counted column of that row; its timed S was measured before the change and is carried here as the before figure, not re-priced.
rho_reference.unit: recorded S per sqrt(subgroup order), both arms from the same process (rule v7)
rho_reference.binary_or_process: rule v7: each price report records one process running both the IC and rho arms. This study: both builds run the same ic price command and params, in the same session and host, round by round.
rho_reference.gae_band_basis: Copied from research/ic_tool_program/rule/v7/rho-reference.json (group k0n53): both full arms were timed in one process with every native operation inside the timed intervals, so the unpriced count is zero and adding 0, 0.1 or 1 GAE per unpriced operation leaves each S unchanged. The IC figure is the pre-change one; the gap to rho is 7.03x, the distance remaining.
